content.text: The excerpt combines several narratives. Lord Evandale is fatally ambushed near Fairy Knowe by Olifant and Burley; Burley and a pursuing Dutch dragoon drown in the Clyde. Morton and Edith later marry, while Lady Margaret regains Tillietudlem. A separate musical history surveys instruments from ancient and medieval cultures. In *The Fair Maid of Perth*, Conachar leaves Simon Glover’s house for the Highlands; Perth citizens travel to Kinfauns to seek Provost Charteris’s aid. Prince Rothsay quarrels with Douglas at the Dominican monastery, while Henry Gow escorts minstrel Louise through the monastery’s passages and garden to his house, where she stays with Nurse Shoolbred. Catharine meets Father Clement near Kinnoull, then encounters Conachar and his Highland guard. Ramorny, confined to his sick chamber, plots revenge with Dwining and Bonthron against Henry. Finally, Proudfute visits Simon Glover’s house and spreads rumors damaging Henry’s courtship of Catharine.
